 Bam Adebayo (hip) is questionable to return to Monday’s game against the Rockets. 
 Adebayo is dealing with tightness in his right hip and did not start the second half of Monday’s game. Andrew Wiggins, who shot 3-of-5 from three in the first half, replaced the Heat center in the starting lineup, which shifted Giannis Antetokounmpo to the five. 
 -  Raphielle Johnson

 Pelle Larsson (illness) said Monday that he expects to be healthy enough to play on Wednesday against the Bucks. 
 Larsson, who’s recovering from a cold, has missed Miami’s last three games. Myron Gardner has filled the void in the starting lineup as head coach Erik Spoelstra continues to bring the struggling Andrew Wiggins off the bench. Larsson should be in the starting lineup on Wednesday if he’s available.

 Pelle Larsson (illness) has been ruled out against the Pistons on Saturday. 
 Larsson will miss a second straight game with this illness. Myron Gardner started in place of Larsson on Friday, though he only played 19 minutes. Andrew Wiggins ended up playing 32 minutes off the bench, though he didn’t provide much value. 
 Bam Adebayo 
 MIA 
 Center-Forward 
 #13 
 Bam Adebayo had 37 points (13-of-19 FGs, 9-of-10 FTs), 14 rebounds, three assists and two three-pointers against the Cavaliers on Friday. 
 Adebayo’s 37 points marked a season-high and the second time this month he’s scored at least 35 points in a game. The 29-year-old center also had a season-high 14 rebounds. Adebayo matched Giannis Antetokounmpo’s point total with 37 as the pair proved to be unstoppable Friday. The Heat will face the Pistons on the second night of a back-to-back Saturday. 
 Giannis Antetokounmpo 
 MIA 
 Forward 
 #7 
 The Miami Heat will start Davion Mitchell, Tim Hardaway Jr., Myron Gardner, Giannis Antetokounmpo, and Bam Adebayo on Friday against the Cavaliers. 
 Pelle Larsson and Klay Thompson are out tonight with injury, so Tim Hardaway Jr. has entered the starting lineup. Myron Gardner gets his first start of the season with Andrew Wiggins remaining on the bench. Gardner has played 20 minutes this season with half of those minutes being played last game against the Jazz.

 Not long after his status was downgraded from probable to questionable, Thompson has been ruled out for Friday’s game. This could lead to Andrew Wiggins rejoining the starting lineup after being benched due to a slow start to the season.

 Miami Heat insider Ira Winderman reports that Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) missed Thursday’s practice. 
 According to Winderman, Thompson injured his ankle on a chase-down block in Tuesday’s matchup with the Jazz. If both Thompson and Larsson end up sitting out Friday’s matchup with the Cavaliers, more minutes could be available for Tim Hardaway Jr. and Andrew Wiggins.
